# Animated Stars commercial asset review

| Shipped resource | Source and distribution basis |
| --- | --- |
| Main and fallback star catalogs | Numeric positions and Hipparcos magnitudes from Floor van Leeuwen's 2007 Hipparcos New Reduction, [CDS I/311](https://vizier.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/VizieR?-source=I%2F311%2Fhip2). The [US Naval Research Laboratory's license notice](https://github.com/USNavalResearchLaboratory/TrackerComponentLibrary/blob/653c01e4af4d1e666e638f4cf3214ed4366889a6/LICENSE.txt) records the Hipparcos helpdesk's confirmation that Hipparcos 2 is public domain. Animated Stars selects rows and converts RA and declination to ICRS unit vectors at epoch J1991.25. |
| Constellation figures | Original connection lists authored for the app using Hipparcos identifiers. IAU names identify the figures. No published map artwork or third-party line lists are included. The [IAU](https://www.iau.org/IAU/Astronomy-FAQs/Constellations.aspx) defines regions of sky and does not prescribe line figures. |
| Playback artwork | The atmospheric layers, glow, and constellation stroke are drawn by [the host generator](../../tools/stars/render-backgrounds.mjs). [Violet Mountains](artwork/violet-mountains-provenance.md), [Twilight Lake](artwork/twilight-lake-provenance.md), and [Desert Mesa](artwork/desert-mesa-provenance.md) were generated from written briefs. |
| Shooting-star trail | Original Animated Aurora artwork generated by [the Aurora effects tool](../../tools/aurora/generate-effects.mjs). The Stars package includes a byte-identical copy of the reviewed texture. |
| Aurora curtain textures | Original Animated Aurora artwork from [the Aurora effects generator](../../tools/aurora/generate-effects.mjs). The eight files match the hashes in Aurora’s reviewed asset manifest. |
| Store poster and two menu covers | OpenAI ImageGen output from a text brief. See [the poster provenance](artwork/animated-stars-roku-poster-provenance.md) and [OpenAI's Terms of Use](https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/). The terms assign OpenAI's rights, if any, in the output. That assignment does not establish exclusive copyright. |
| Text | Roku system fonts. The app redistributes no font files. |
| Shared Roku runtime | The target includes the repository's shared lifecycle helper and its existing [RokuCommunity MIT notice](../../shared/runtime/data/third-party-licenses.txt). The MIT license permits sale and requires retention of the notice. Compiler, linter, analyzer, and renderer binaries remain on the host. |

The app bundles a source and artwork notice, also visible in **Credits &
Licenses** in external settings. This review covers the assets in the local
build. Store submission and its distribution agreement are separate steps.

# Animated Stars Roku poster provenance

The 540 × 405 PNG is promotional artwork for Animated Stars. The twilight
lake, sky, stylized Orion figure, and title were generated together with
OpenAI ImageGen from a written brief. No supplied photo, stock image, or
separately licensed font file was used in the generation or export. The
constellation is illustrative.

OpenAI assigns its rights in generated output, if any, to the user under
its applicable terms. Generated output may be similar to other output.
See the [OpenAI Terms of Use](https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/).

# Desert Mesa foreground

The built-in OpenAI ImageGen tool created this fictional Southwest landscape
from a written brief. The asset uses generated artwork with no reference
photograph or stock art.

## Generation brief

> Create a photorealistic wide cutout of desert terrain for a very dark astronomy screensaver, with a transparent sky and a continuous opaque landscape reaching the bottom and both side edges. Wide landscape canvas 3:2. Leave top 75% entirely transparent. The bottom ~25% is an expansive natural American Southwest landscape photographed from ground level at astronomical twilight, with distant low, layered eroded sandstone mesas arranged asymmetrically, subtle stratified rock, overlapping atmospheric depth, a gentle gravel plain and sparse tiny scrub. The tallest mesa is in the left third with a quiet lower ridge to the right. Use very subdued cool charcoal and dark russet rock tones, with enough reflected blue-hour skylight to read the rock strata. No artificial lighting, no orange glow, no star or moon, no fog or clouds, no foreground cliff close to camera. Single photographic exposure, realistic erosion and scale, no graphic outlines, no cartoon, no painterly surface, no cutout shadow, no lettering. Preserve sharp natural alpha along the skyline, solid terrain all the way across the lower edge. Avoid a centered symmetrical skyline.

## Runtime export

FFmpeg cropped a 1536 × 272 strip starting at y=656 from the 1536 × 1024
source, scaled it to 1920 × 190, and normalized the alpha channel so the sky
is transparent and the bottom edge is opaque. Playback draws the strip at
y=890 and the settings preview scales that same strip. The Desert Mesa sky
palette is generated separately by
[render-backgrounds.mjs](../../../tools/stars/render-backgrounds.mjs).

The packaged `images/desert-mesa-ground.png` has SHA-256
`e3219fe18b6dc9d3cc433848bdc3bfabfebae6a7487a05dc6098ae4d145827b0`.

See [OpenAI's Terms of Use](https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/) and
the [commercial asset review](../RIGHTS.md).

# Twilight Lake foreground

OpenAI ImageGen created this fictional lake and distant mountains from a
written brief. No reference photo or stock art was used as input. The
foreground includes the shoreline, water ripples, and a copper reflection.
The app draws the sky gradient and moving catalog stars separately.

The transparent image was resized to the 1920 × 1080 layout with macOS
`sips`. FFmpeg exported the bottom 230 rows and scaled them to a 1920 × 190
RGBA strip. The runtime anchors that strip at y=890. The packaged asset,
`images/twilight-lake-ground.png`, has SHA-256
`6249ee582805668e190c3a65941168c1b7cfed3627198744bfcd9a9814660160`.

See [OpenAI's Terms of Use](https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/) and the
[commercial asset review](../RIGHTS.md).

# Violet Mountains foreground

The foreground in Animated Stars 0.1.5 was generated with OpenAI ImageGen
from a written brief for an invented mountain landscape. The brief called
for a low mountain ridge with layered foothills, subtle rock and forest
detail, and a transparent sky. No reference photograph or stock art was
used as input. The sky color and catalog stars are drawn by the app.

The transparent output was resized to the 1920 × 1080 layout with macOS
`sips` and exported as the bottom 1920 × 190 RGBA strip with FFmpeg. The
scene positions it at y=890. The checked-in runtime asset is
`screensavers/stars/src/images/violet-mountains-ground.png`. Its SHA-256 is
`ad6bf8939b88d3c845e2f12c1f1ad1e0e3011342cc5f2aeb13a9a12e13adf77e`.

See [OpenAI's Terms of Use](https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/) and the
[commercial asset review](../RIGHTS.md).
